title: The descent of the worlds: Keser of Beriya, the curtains, and the angels and mazalos
overview: This chapter continues the descent of the light through the curtains into the worlds. The Malchus of Atzilus, passing through the curtain, becomes the Keser of Beriya, the will to create yesh me'ayin. From that Keser come Abba and Ima of Beriya and Zeir Anpin, and the same pattern repeats: the Malchus of Beriya makes the souls and angels, and the ten sefiros of Beriya hold lights, vessels, garments and heichalos. Each step down needs a curtain and an interface, a parsa, that translates the will from one world to the next. The verse For My glory I created, formed and made hints at the four worlds; Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya are the separate worlds, seen from our side, and correspond to thought, speech and action. In Beriya, Avraham's neshama comes from the inner vessels of chesed and Michael's from the outer ones. The Serafim, Chayos and Ofanim stand in the three worlds. Metatron, the outer system of the Torah, is corrupted without a soul to direct him. Finally, the mazalos, fine-tuned within a narrow range and ruled by the Malchus of Malchus of Asiya: a decree with no logic to it, and a revelation of the Ein Sof.

sections.title: The Keser of Beriya is Malchus of Atzilus coming down through the curtain

blocks.text: The discussion of the *seder hishtalshelus* is nearly done. Now the light passes the curtain between *Atzilus* and *Beriya*: *Malchus* of *Atzilus* becomes the *Keser* of *Beriya*.
This *Keser*, which is *Atik* of *Beriya*, comes from the *Malchus* of the *Malchus* of *Atzilus*. A higher world's *Malchus* becomes the lower world's *Keser*, its inner pleasure.

Take Torah. The Talmud and the rest are in *Beriya*; when we learn, we try to grasp what G-d said in the Written Torah. *Malchus* is the desire to relate to someone separate from you, and that desire creates the pleasure of making separate beings: *yesh me'ayin*.

blocks.text: The will that arose to emanate the *sefiros* went down to become the will to create, stage by stage, from the first circle of the *ratzon kadum* through the whole *seder hishtalshelus*.

A person who wants to build a house plans it: first the concepts, what it must do (host guests, so a large dining room), then the designs and the building plan, which is *Yetzira* and *Asiya*. So the inner desire becomes a desire to create *yesh me'ayin*: the *Keser* of *Malchus* of *Beriya*.

blocks.text: So Rabbi Yishmael was entering the *Kodesh Kodashim* of *Beriya*, where the light of the *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* comes down to be the *Keser* of *Beriya*. Bless Me means draw Me down. The answer is a desire before Him.

The job of the Kohen Gadol, or a rav on that level, is like an architect's: to translate an inner desire into an outer one and say what it means for the house. He translated G-d's inner desire for a *dira b'tachtonim* into a new will to create, expressing mercy for the Jewish people.

blocks.text: From *Zeir Anpin* the flow goes to the *Malchus* of *Beriya*, the same process as in *Atzilus*, now in the terms of *Beriya*. In *Atzilus* all is pure G-dliness; in *Beriya* it is Torah and mitzvos, or creating *neshamos* and *malachim*.

The *Malchus* of *Beriya* is the source that makes the world of *Beriya*: its souls and *malachim*, from nothing. As the *osios* of *Malchus* create the world on each level, the souls are like the *osios* of thought and the angels like the *osios* of speech.

sections.title: Each world is cut off from the next by a curtain, and a translation passes through it
sections.summary: The same pattern repeats between *Beriya* and *Yetzira*, and between *Yetzira* and *Asiya*. Each crossing needs an interface, a *parsa*, that translates the will from one realm to the next.

phrases.he: ומבחינת מלכות דבריאה נעשה בחינת כתר ועתיק יומין דעולם היצירה,
phrases.en: comes down to create the world of *Yetzira*

phrases.he: גם כן על ידי בקיעת מסך שבין בריאה ליצירה,
phrases.en: this curtain that separates the world of *Beriya* to the world of *Yetzira*

phrases.he: על דרך הנזכר לעיל במסך שבין אצילות לבריאה
phrases.en: just like before when we had this curtain between *Atzilus* and *Beriya*

blocks.text: *Malchus* of *Beriya* becomes the *Keser* and *Atik Yomin* of *Yetzira*. It comes down through a curtain between *Beriya* and *Yetzira*, just as between *Atzilus* and *Beriya*.

The general structure repeats, tuned to each level. In the *Kuntres Inyana shel Toras HaChassidus* the Rebbe applies *pshat*, *remez*, *drush* and *sod* to the worlds. *Pshat* and *Asiya* are human experience; *remez* and *Yetzira* the outside world of the sciences; *drush* and *Beriya* morality, asking what my purpose is; *Atzilus* the G-dliness of the *sefiros* inside the outer world.

phrases.he: דכמו שעלה ברצונו לברוא, כך עלה ברצונו ליצירה ועשיה,
phrases.en: just like it arose in His desire to create, it also arose in His desire to form and to make everything

phrases.he: רק שצריך להיות הפסק פרסא בין סוף מעשה דרצון דבריאה, לתחלת הרצון דיצירה
phrases.en: but in order to go from one world to the other, there has to be this break

blocks.text: Just as the will arose to create, it arose to form and to make. Between one world and the next there must be a break, a *parsa* or *masach*, where the will goes through and is translated.
*Malchus* is the idea of a language: it lets you speak to another person and carry your ideas from your mind to theirs. Each time you go from one realm to another you need such an interface.
blocks.title: Language as an interface

sections.title: The four worlds and the three separate worlds: thought, speech and action
sections.summary: The verse For My glory I created, formed and made hints at the four worlds. *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are the separate worlds, seen from our side, and they correspond to thought, speech and action.

phrases.en: and like it says
for My glory I have created, I formed, and I've even made

blocks.text: The verse *lichvodi bara'tiv yatzarti'v af asitiv* hints at the four worlds: *lichvodi* is *Atzilus*, *bara'tiv* *Beriya*, *yatzarti'v* *Yetzira*, *asitiv* *Asiya*. The *af* between them is the extra distance to actual action; thought and speech are more connected. It is hinted at in the letter *heh*: the top two lines join, and the bottom line stands apart.

phrases.en: and it's known
that the three worlds of *Beriya*, *Yetzira*, and *Asiya*, they're called the three separate worlds

blocks.text: In *Atzilus* everything is seen in terms of G-d and His will. From *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, G-d is a detached source that creates and gives life, and we pray for reward and success. That comes through a curtain, like sunlight through a curtain: you see the benefit, not the source. These are the separate worlds, created from nothing.

phrases.he: היינו כדוגמת התהוות אותיות המחשבה ודבור ומעשה
phrases.en: here, these three worlds of *Beriya*, *Yetzira*, and *Asiya* relate to *machshava*, *dibur*, and *maaseh*, thought, speech, and action

phrases.he: שבאים בבחינת יש נפרד לעצמו ממש
phrases.en: but this is like a person's thought, speech, and action becoming separate from the person, to the point where if you say something and do something, it's totally out of your hands

blocks.text: The three worlds correspond to *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh*, and the pattern goes back to *Adam Kadmon*: *Atik* and *Arich* of *Atzilus* relate to *Yetzira*, *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus* to *Asiya*. It is very fractal. A person's thought, speech and action become separate from him; once you say or do something, it is out of your hands.

phrases.he: כך מבחינת אותיות המחשבה דמדות דאלהי״ם דבריאה, הנקרא זעיר אנפין דבריאה כנזכר לעיל, נבראו מזה בחינת עלמין סתימין דלא אתגליין, שהן נשמות ומלאכים דעולם הבריאה מאין ליש ממש
phrases.en: they're created something from nothing

blocks.text: From the *osios* of thought of the middos of *Elokim* of *Beriya*, which is *Zeir Anpin* of *Beriya*, the hidden worlds were made: the *neshamos* and *malachim* of *Beriya*, from nothing.

sections.title: Avraham's kindness comes from the inside of the vessels, Michael's from the outside
sections.summary: The *neshama* of Avraham comes from the inner vessels of the *chesed* of *Zeir Anpin*, the *malachim* of kindness from the outer ones. The Gan Eden of *Beriya* is the pleasure of its *Keser*, received through *bina*.

phrases.en: like for example the *neshama* of *Avraham*

phrases.he: אוהבי מבחינת פנימיות הכלים דחסד דזעיר אנפין שבמלכות דבריאה, ומיכאל דעולם הבריאה מבחינת חיצוניות הכלים ואותיות דחסד דזעיר אנפין דבריאה כו'

blocks.text: The *neshama* of Avraham comes from the inner vessels of the *chesed* of *Zeir Anpin* in *Malchus* of *Beriya*. *Neshamos* come from the inner vessels, and the *malachim* from the outer ones, as we will see.

Michael's kindness comes from the outer vessels and letters of that *chesed*. In our *avodah*, I think, a kindness G-d sends us is one aspect of a *malach* of Michael; a kindness that connects the *neshama* to its root is the *penimiyus* of Avraham.

Or a person does kindness because the Torah says to, without deep care: that is the outer kindness of Michael. Or G-d puts nature into every person, even animals, to care for children and have mercy: those are *malachim* of kindness, as against Avraham's, which was intentional and came from deeper.

phrases.he: וכן גן עדן העליון דבריאה, היינו מבחינת אור הכתר דבריאה, שהוא התענוג העליון שנקרא עתיק דבריאה, שמתצמצם בבינה שבמלכות דבריאה, שהנשמות דבריאה נהנין מזיו כו'

blocks.text: The upper *Gan Eden* of *Beriya* is the light of the *Keser* of *Beriya*, the highest pleasure, *Atik* of *Beriya*, contracted in the *bina* of *Malchus* of *Beriya*, where the *neshamos* enjoy its radiance. It is the satisfaction a person gets through his *avodah* and understanding G-dliness.

phrases.en: as is known
that the upper mother, which is *bina*, it says she nests in her throne
this is the light of *bina* of *Atzilus*

phrases.he: על ידי השתלשלות רבות עד בינה דמלכות דאצילות בבינה שבמלכות דבריאה כו', ועל דרך זה זעיר אנפין דאצילות מקנן ביצירה ומלכות בעשיה כו')

blocks.text: *Imma Ila'ah* nests in the throne, the light of *bina* of *Atzilus*, as is known. Its light comes down through many stages to the *bina* of the *Malchus* of *Beriya*. The inner G-dly understanding, higher than human intellect, is the *bina* of *Atzilus*; it comes down into the Torah we can understand and into a person's mind. In the same way *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus* rests in *Yetzira*, and *Malchus* of *Atzilus* is expressed in *Asiya*.

In each world there is a way to experience G-dliness and its pleasure: in the world of understanding, in the world of doing, and in the world of emotions, love and fear of G-d, which is *Yetzira*. Each has an outer part, what we do, and a deeper connection, *emunah* from our *neshama*, the G-dly experience the *Kuntres HaTefila* describes, between how the *neshama* is in Gan Eden and how it comes down.

sections.title: Serafim, Chayos and Ofanim stand in the worlds; Metatron is the outer system and needs a soul
sections.summary: The *Serafim*, *Chayos* and *Ofanim* stand in the three worlds. *Metatron*, the angel of *Beriya*, is the outer vessels of the religion, and without a *neshama* any angel, however great, is corrupted.

phrases.en: and this is also the idea of the angels called the *Serafim*
and it says the *Serafim* are in the world of *Beriya*
and these are what are called the children of G-d that sit

phrases.he: על יהו״ה שהוא בחינת זעיר אנפין דבריאה

blocks.text: The *Serafim* are a metaphor, not physical fire; they are in *Beriya*. *Chassidus* says the *Serafim* are generally in *Beriya*, the *Chayos* in *Yetzira* and the *Ofanim* in *Asiya*. Other places say otherwise, maybe a whole *pilpul*. They are the children of G-d who stand above Hashem.

These are *Zeir Anpin* of *Beriya*, the *malachim*: the desire to understand what is beyond you, like a fire that wants to rise above the physical world. That desire brings a person to seek G-d beyond how G-dliness is expressed in the world.

phrases.en: and then the *kelim* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Beriya*

phrases.he: הוא בחינת מטטרו״ן, שרו של עולם הבריאה, שנאמר בו כי שמי בקרבו,

blocks.text: The *kelim* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Beriya* are *Metatron*: the external system of Torah, the external religion, the logic of the Talmud and the codified law. The inner aspect of religion is the *Shechina*.

blocks.text: *Metatron* means something like a teacher. It says *Yisroel* is *sar kal*, that we rule over angels. An angel is any system: logic, habits, biology, psychology, emotions, the laws of nature, gravity and the speed of light.
blocks.title: Metatron, the teacher

blocks.text: Some angels are the laws of the physical world, some the workings of our cells and emotions, and some are made by people: ideologies, religions, governments.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: *Azza* and *Azazel*, said to have fallen at the beginning of creation, are the general angels of government and of religion: *Azza* means I am powerful, *Azazel* G-d is powerful. Any angel, however great, is dangerous without a soul. A soul connects to something higher, to empathize and see deeper, and you always need it to direct things. An angel becomes corrupted when it is not directed; it is tempting to just commit to a system, like selling one's soul to the devil.

blocks.text: The *nefilim*, in the simple reading, were the princes and leaders of that time, who became corrupted and made themselves into gods. Today it is movie stars, celebrities and gurus, or someone who represents a theology or a political belief, who becomes larger than life.

blocks.text: A person who gives up his soul and lets the angel take over lets it become corrupt. Systems that exist to keep the system going eat themselves from inside, like Enron, and as now in physics.

blocks.text: *Yisroel* means *li rosh*. When a person's G-dly soul is turned on, he becomes a creative force, connecting to the inner *hiyuli*, as the Rambam says. The sign is altruism: he wants to know the truth because it is true, and to do what is right because it is right.

blocks.text: On that level he controls the angels, seeing them as tools for something higher. He is ready for *mesiras nefesh*, so nothing stops him from doing what is right.

blocks.text: That is the power of the soul. When people let angels control souls, the angels become corrupt and evil, like the *satan*. Even the best angel is not enough alone: *Metatron*, the angel of religion, is a good angel that becomes corrupt.

blocks.text: Religion without the *Shechina* is harsh and judgmental: if you fit in, good; if not, get out. A person who sees the *Shechina* sees the inner purpose, that the Torah was given to help the Jewish people, and sees with mercy.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: That was the idea of the Kohen Gadol, which the *tzitz* represents: Rabbi Yishmael was bringing *Atzilus* down into *Beriya*, imbuing religion with it. A Jewish leader needs the system but must imbue it with the *Shechina*'s inner mercy.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: A school needs rules, but the purpose of the school is the children, not the system. A leader needs that inner mercy and flexibility from recognizing what is really important: Torah and mitzvos are to help people reveal their potential.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: That blessing makes mercy overpower judgment: the thirteen *middos* of mercy, the source of forgiveness. The Golden Calf came after the giving of the Torah, and G-d set it up to reveal that there is something deeper than Torah, a deeper connection of forgiveness and *teshuva*. Otherwise it becomes bad.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: Like you were just saying, a naturally introverted person has a nature that is an angel. The Rebbe would push a person to overcome it and do *mivtzaim*, asking people, Are you Jewish? That is Avraham's test for the *Akeida*: his kindness was not only his nature; if he needs *gevura* he will have it.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: A person with a *neshama* can change. The inside of a *kli* is connected to the light and the soul; the outside is fixed and separate. The external tools, the dress code, the laws and customs, are very powerful, but you must remember their soul: their inner purpose.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: The *Zohar* says people serve the servant instead of the King, serving *Metatron* instead of G-d, a big cause of *galus*. *Penimiyus* means doing a thing because this is who you are, not for other people.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: If you do things because of parents, teachers and society, it is stifling and judgmental. At a Shabbaton at his shul a panel's big theme was how to get children involved without resentment, and how to get them to want to *daven*.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: That is the heart of it. Is it the *chitzoniyus* way, here is the angel, conform? Or: I see who you are, I value you, I want you to be your best self? The sign of the deeper perspective is mercy, flexible as appropriate, not crushing people against the law or system.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: There are two sides. When a person is not mature enough, as Moshe hoped to bring the whole people to his level with the essence of Torah, the Ten Commandments, would have sufficed. They were not mature enough, so everything had to be legislated.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: It is comical that you must tell someone exactly how to have a vacation. A workaholic asks if he can check email and make calls, and in the end you must list everything he may not do. That is the idea of *Metatron*.
blocks.title: A vacation
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: To codify every detail of Shabbos for someone not on that level is very important: everyone has a *nefesh habehamis* that needs refining, so it needs *malachim*, systems in place.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: Everyone has that part that needs systems. In high-stress work, like police on chases, you train people so they do not have to think and do the right thing. So it is a necessity for those not on that level.
blocks.title: Police training
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: The other side is a kind of punishment: without the *bittul* necessary for the *Shechina*, you will not have the *Shechina*. Moshe struggled to connect people to the *Shechina* and still give them what they need. In the end there will always be leaders connected to the *Shechina*, as G-d promised him.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: The *mefarshim*: in *Shema*, Moshe said first *v'ahavta*, which says nothing of reward and punishment, then *v'haya im shamo'a*, a lower level with reward and punishment. That is intrinsic and extrinsic motivation. In *Devarim* he speaks sometimes to *Yisroel* and sometimes to the *am*, the *erev rav*.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: Moshe spoke to *Yisroel* with the mask off and to the *erev rav* with the mask on. A parent or teacher does the same: a mature person does not care about grades and rules, but you put on a mask and pretend you care, because at a certain level people need that.
blocks.title: The mask of Moshe
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: It is supposed to be a mask. I don't know if there was a real mask or only a metaphor, probably a real one. Either way it shows they were not worthy of the inner circle, which creates the necessary *bittul*, so one day they will achieve it.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: Kings sat behind a curtain so they could be seen by fewer, which kept the proper respect. A king cannot sit on his throne all the time; this way he can relax and the people still keep their distance.
blocks.title: The king behind the curtain
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: You can set up business systems that run things, but you need a person behind them who knows what they are for. Likewise with AI and computers: technology is *malachim*, not souls. It does external things but not real consciousness, creativity or empathy. We'll see that as it progresses. This is the external *kelim* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Beriya*: *Metatron*.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: *Metatron* is the *sar* of *Beriya*, of whom it says *ki shmi b'kirbo*, My Name is in him: the Havaya of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus* inside the external logic of halacha. A real rabbi paskens through the system, based on G-dliness higher than logic, as R' Leviq, the Rebbe's father, wrote.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: The real determinant is *emunah* and *ruach hakodesh*: seeing what G-dliness is, appreciating the holiness of a *neshama*, of the Torah and mitzvos, and of what Shabbos is meant to accomplish.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

blocks.text: Shabbos brings out the sense that we have an intrinsic connection to G-d, so we don't need the mindset of accomplishing things; it is being alive and experiencing G-d's world. With that sensitivity a person sees and feels G-dliness, and that informs how he paskens and reads the logic.
blocks.outOfPlace: Line 19 is read at 20:43 and explained here; its LINE mark sits at 38:27 (confidence 0.645).

sections.title: Metatron is the immature face of Zeir Anpin; Beriya is the world of thought
sections.summary: *Metatron* is called a *naar* relative to the great face of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus*. In general *Beriya* is the hidden world of thought; *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are the revealed worlds, made with the letters yud and heh.

phrases.en: and so *Metatron* is called a *naar*, is called like a little kid because it's immature
a small face or an immature face

phrases.he: לגבי בחינת אנפי רברבי בחינת זעיר אנפין דאצילות כידוע)

blocks.text: *Metatron* is a *naar*, a little kid: the small face, *anpin zutri*, next to the great face of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus*. Doing a thing only because the book says so is immature, though a good approximation is what the codifying is for.
The inner reasons for the mitzvos will be revealed when Moshiach comes, but a true Jewish leader has them now as well.

phrases.he: ובכלל נקרא עולם הבריאה עולם המחשבה,
phrases.en: and in general we call the world of *Beriya* the world of thought
the hidden worlds

blocks.text: *Beriya* is the world of thought, the hidden worlds. The yud of the world to come is the yud of *machshava*: hidden, like a point.

phrases.en: like it says

phrases.he: ביו"ד נברא העולם הבא, שהוא יו"ד דמחשבה דבינה דמלכות דבריאה כו', ובה' נברא העולם הזה בחינת היצירה והעשיה)
phrases.en: with the *heh*, which is like the idea of speech, that's what created the worlds of *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, which are the revealed worlds

blocks.text: With the heh, the idea of speech, the revealed worlds of *Yetzira* and *Asiya* were created. *Beriya* and *Atzilus* are the inner reality: a person's identity, meaning, purpose and morality are inner, not scientific questions. Science cannot answer why we are here; you have to look inside.

sections.title: Yetzira is the revealed world of speech, and the prophets of the chariot differ by world
sections.summary: *Yetzira* is called the world of speech, the revealed worlds. Yeshaya spoke from the level of *Beriya*, and Yechezkel of *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, of the *Chayos* and *Ofanim* that say Baruch.

phrases.he: ועולם היצירה, עולם הדבור, עלמין דאתגליין
phrases.en: and the world of *Yetzira* is called the world of speech, that's the revealed worlds

phrases.he: כו' (וכמו נבואות ישעיהו בשרפים דבריאה שאומרים קדוש, ויחזקאל בחיות ואופנים שאומרים ברוך
phrases.en: for example, there's two prophecies of the divine chariot

blocks.text: *Yetzira* is the world of speech, the revealed worlds. As an example, there are two prophecies of the *Merkava*. Yeshaya was on the level of *Beriya*, so he did not speak of the details, of the *Serafim* saying Kadosh.

A person from the capital talks only about the king, not the buildings and guards he is used to. A villager is amazed by the tall buildings, horses and army. Yechezkel saw the chariot in *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, so he spoke of the *Chayos* and *Ofanim* that say Baruch.
blocks.title: The capital and the village

blocks.text: The *Serafim* of *Beriya* are the desire to know the truth and go beyond the physical world. The *Chayos* and *Ofanim* are the Baruch: how it is brought down into the physical world.

sections.title: The ten sefiros of Yetzira and Asiya repeat the pattern; prophecy comes from Netzach and Hod
sections.summary: The ten *sefiros* of *Yetzira* and of *Asiya* repeat the process of *Beriya*, through a curtain, with the same *partzufim*. The prophets see from *Netzach* and *Hod* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Yetzira*.

phrases.he: ועל דרך הנזכר לעיל בעשר ספירות דבריאה,
phrases.en: and just like we said with the ten *sefiros* of *Beriya*

phrases.he: כך הוא בעשר ספירות דיצירה ועשר ספירות דעשיה,

phrases.en: with all the little details

phrases.he: באורות וכלים ולבושים והיכלות כו', והתהוות המלאכים ונשמות דיצירה
phrases.en: and then there's the creation of the angels and the souls of *Yetzira*

phrases.he: הוא כמו סנדלפון ודי למבין כו'

blocks.text: The same process repeats in the ten *sefiros* of *Yetzira* and of *Asiya*: the *Malchus* of the higher world goes through a *masach*, becomes the inner *Keser* and *Atik*, and then the *partzufim* run through the whole process.

Here he says angels and then souls: the main thing of the *neshama* is in *Beriya* and of the *malachim* in *Yetzira*. *Metatron* is the general angel of *Beriya*, and *Sandalfon*, called the shoe of the *Shechina*, is the general angel of *Yetzira*.

The body of halacha is *Metatron*; the customs are *Sandalfon*. Communities that follow the same halachos differ in how they do them: gefilte fish, cholent with or without chickpeas, how people dress. Those external expressions are not essential, but they are very important, the way of a culture.

phrases.he: שכל נבואת הנביאים מבחינת נצח והוד דזעיר אנפין דיצירה כידוע
phrases.en: the prophecy of the *neviim*, they're seeing from *netzach* and *hod* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Yetzira*

blocks.text: The prophets see from *Netzach* and *Hod* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Yetzira*, only how G-dliness comes down into the physical world. From there they reason up to the higher levels.

sections.title: A curtain divides Yetzira from Asiya; the souls of Asiya are the five levels of soul
sections.summary: The same kind of curtain divides *Yetzira* from *Asiya*, and *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira* becomes the *Keser* of *Asiya*. *Kuntres HaHispaalus* gives five levels of soul, and the *Ofanim* receive from the *Malchus* of *Asiya*.

phrases.he: ועל דרך זה יש מסך מפסיק בין יצירה לעשיה
phrases.en: and in a similar way there's this *masach* separating between *Yetzira* and *Asiya*

phrases.he: ובחינת מלכות דמלכות דיצירה נעשה כתר ועתיק יומין לעשיה,
phrases.en: and again from there's a curtain separating *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, and from the *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira* becomes a *Keser* and *Atik Yomin* of *Asiya*

phrases.he: שזהו מה שכתוב כל אשר חפץ יהו״ה עשה
phrases.en: and like it says that everything G-d desires He does

blocks.text: A *masach* separates *Yetzira* from *Asiya*; *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira* becomes the *Keser* of *Asiya*. The will comes down from the *Ratzon Kadum* through all the worlds to a will in *Asiya*: that is what whatever G-d desires He does means.

phrases.en: and these are the souls and the angels of the world of *Asiya*
and the lower *Gan Eden* of *Asiya*, until the angels that are called the *Ofanim*

phrases.he: עד האופנים שמקבלים מבחינת מלכות דמלכות דעשיה כידוע
phrases.en: which receive from *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, as is known

blocks.text: The souls and angels of *Asiya*, and the lower *Gan Eden* of *Asiya*, down to the *Ofanim*, receive from the *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*. *Kuntres HaHispaalus* names five levels of soul: *nefesh*, *ruach*, *neshama*, *chaya* and *yechida*. A person has them all. The part that does its duty is *Asiya*; love and fear is *Yetzira*; a deep understanding that sees it is *Beriya*.

Souls differ in level. The higher the soul, the greater the *tzaddik* and leader; a more mature person naturally leads, and those lower defer. A person with the deeper perspective leads. The *malachim* come in aspects: the *Chayos* are the basic forces, the four elements, gravity, electromagnetism and light from the sun; the *Ofanim* are cycles, combinations of letters.

The *Ofanim* are permutations. Each day and each climate gets a slightly different mix of light, heat, cloud, radiation, wind, humidity and soil acidity, which changes how plants grow and people develop there. A tree's rings show the weather it grew in.
blocks.title: Ofanim and the weather

blocks.text: In halacha, the logic is the *Serafim*, the basic *psak* of what is forbidden and permitted; the *Shulchan Aruch* is the *Chayos*; the application to infinite situations is the *Ofanim*. So the halachos are infinite.

sections.title: The mazalos and the four elements are fine-tuned, and G-d's rule is above logic
sections.summary: The influences of the *galgalim* and the *mazalos* are the dregs of the *Ofanim*, tuned within a narrow range. Everything comes from *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, a decree beyond logic, and science names its laws without seeing the Ein Sof.

phrases.he: הוא שנמשך שרש השפעת גלגל המזלות, שהן שרשים של כל דומם צומח חי ומדבר שבכל אקלים, ושרשי הרכבות הד' יסודות דאש רוח מים ועפר
phrases.en: and this is also the source of the combination of the four elements of *esh*, *ruach*, *mayim*, *afar*, fire, wind, water, and earth, or solid, liquid, gas, and plasma
and this is going from spiritual to physical

blocks.text: The dregs of the *Ofanim* are the root of the influence of the *galgal hamazalos*: the sun's rising and setting, and the moon's tides, change the *Ofanim* we get, but only within a very small subset of what is possible.

The six days of creation made the world stable. If the temperature changed by more than a little, everything would die; the same if we were a little closer or farther from the sun. If the magnetic field were a little weaker, everything would have to be very finely tuned.

What can come physically for us to exist is the *shmarei Ofanim*, the tiniest bit of possibilities. Our universe is fine-tuned for all its constants. What G-d could create but cannot exist physically lives in fantasy and fiction.

The *shmarei Ofanim* enter the *galgalim hamazalos*, roots of all the *domem*, *tzomeiach*, *chai* and *medaber* of each climate. Those come from the *Ofanim*, the *Chayos*, the *Serafim*, and the letters of *Malchus*, where G-d dictates that reality be as it is.
You can see the Ein Sof in certain things. Gravity is intrinsic and infinite: a string hangs forever. A magnet holding a paper clip does the same. It is a little spark of the Ein Sof revealed.

Heat is energy, which is essential and is not created or destroyed. G-d created a set amount of energy *yesh me'ayin*, and it moves as *mashpia* and *mekabel*, giving and receiving, so it can be gained or lost.

Because energy gives and receives, it has the form of a *kav* that can be measured. All the g-dly things come down through the angels to the sun and moon, which channel them into the physical world. This is also the source of the four elements: fire, wind, water and earth, or solid, liquid, gas and plasma. G-d sets the sun and moon so that the combinations make the world as it is, which is where physics, chemistry and biology come in.
In all these sciences the laws are the angels, and the physical mechanisms that put things in one state or another are these *mazalos*.

phrases.en: like it says there's certain lands that grow wise people
because it says the *mazal* makes a person wise

phrases.he: כו', עד ממגד תבואות שמש כו', עד שיש בחינת מזל דומם, כמו גדא דהר, עד מזל דומם שבדומם, על דרך שאמרו אין לך עשב שאין לו מזל

blocks.text: Certain lands grow wise people, because the *mazal* makes a person wise. Circumstances suit certain things: developments came in certain places because of the right resources, which may not be fully understood.
Landmass and resources give stability or not, so people worry about war, famine or disease. These affect societies in different ways.
Those influence peoples physically, in nutrients, height and skin color, and in technology and politics. Big societies are hard to rule in mountains, so mountain peoples tend to be tribal.

sensitivity.reason: Generalises about peoples by landmass: their height and skin colour, and that mountain peoples are tribal. A remark about races and nations, in the mazal teaching.
sensitivity.publishable: Those influence peoples physically, in nutrients, and in technology and politics. Big societies are hard to rule in mountains.
sensitivity.judgmentNote: Whether the claims about height, skin colour and tribal character belong in the public edition. The teaching that landmass and resources shape societies stands without them.

blocks.text: The *mazal* affects the way things grow: some things grow from the sun and some from the moon, and there is even a *mazal* over rocks.

There is a *mazal* over people, over plants and over rocks; gold and diamonds are where the conditions are right. He mentions a phrase about mountains he has to look up and cannot recall. As it says, there is not a blade of grass without a *mazal*.

phrases.he: ועל המזלות מושל בחינת מלכות דמלכות דעשיה,
phrases.en: but all these *mazalos* are being controlled by *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*
it is known
like it says, Your kingship rules over everything
like it says, Your whatever reign is over everything
like we will explain with the help of G-d

blocks.text: All the *mazalos* are controlled by *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, so G-d dictates exactly how it is set up and how it works. That hides G-d's involvement, because we say our life comes from the sun. But G-d creates the sun and gives it its properties, and everything is determined by G-d saying it should be so, with no logic to it in the end.

Your reign is over everything. It is worth thinking about these things, because they bring it down to what we can relate to. Even as we come down to *Asiya* and the physical, it is literally a revelation of the *Atzmus*, the *Ein Sof*, through all these stages.

Richard Feynman, as a boy pulling a wagon, asked his father why the ball rolled to the back. Inertia, his father said, which is what scientists call it. You can name it and do the math, which is the angel of it; ultimately it is a decree of G-d, the *ratzon* of the *Ein Sof* revealed in physical things.
blocks.title: Feynman and the wagon

blocks.text: It is good to learn the *malachim* and the math; it helps build bridges and medicines. But in every *hisbonenus* you see two sides: the *yesh* you can understand, and the *ein* beyond understanding, which is literally the *ratzon* of Hashem.

reviewQuestions.question: How does the Keser of Beriya come down from the Malchus of Atzilus?
Why must each step from one world to the next pass through a curtain and an interface?
What is the job of the Kohen Gadol in the story of Yishmael ben Berachni?
Why do the neshamos come from the inner vessels and the malachim from the outer vessels?
Why does an angel without a soul become corrupted, and what is the example?
How do the mazalos and the four elements depend on the Malchus of Malchus of Asiya?
